statement: Pulse is making a legend talent tier list as he goes; it may be difficult
Super talent points: +1 per milestone, spend on talents for extra levels. S tier, among the strongest, one of the first to pick.
Super talent points let him push already strong talents into super talents; he gets an extra 125 levels from this.
Super duper talent buffs the previous talent for 10 extra levels per point, costs more per point.
Super duper talent tentatively A tier; worse than super talent point for point but still one of the best on the board.
Shrine World Order Bill makes shrines gain exp from exp gains no matter which world you are in; very good.
Not as critical as super talents since you can minmax by placing shrines in the town you need.
Shrine talent is A tier (maybe S) because shrines keep their exp when moved; he would still take super talent first.
Recycled particle upgrades spends 100% of alternate particle upgrades daily evenly across the first bubbles of each color for free, but requires logging in.
Recycled particle upgrades is easy D tier, maybe the worst on the board; if you log in you would just use atom clicks instead.
Obsolete No More: the Equinox Valley metal detector bonus no longer resets when you find a new best nugget; meta for pushing deeper into nugget.
Obsolete No More is S tier because it is meta defining.
Double Ain't Nothing: statue and gold food drops come in bundles of 8x instead of 2x; level three base and six with research node.
Double Ain't Nothing is meta defining S tier: lets characters reach tens of millions of gold food drops and statues in the 7-800 range.
Blue Ribbon Certification gives plus ribbons every day for the cooking ribbon shelf; ribbons are insanely timegated with few other sources for free to play.
Ribbon talent costs about seven points so hard to call S, but at minimum A tier.
Extended database talent gives 60 max level for the fifth column of farming land ranks; very good because world 6 database nodes are good.
Fifth land rank column: huge stealth per farming level, a big drop rate increase (3000 flat), extra total damage and all stat bonus. Pretty strong.
Land rank fifth column talent is a three to six pointer; hard to place but it is A tier.
Compared with the other A tiers he places ribbons at A.
Cog Lover claims more jeweled cogs every day if unlocked; jeweled cogs are meta for construction with a big gulf over purple cogs.
Cog Lover is A tier (floating between B and A); very strong and necessary for its mechanic.
Crook Bubblin gives extra bubble levels per day for each of Cancer Crook's bubbles; endgame Crook is straight RNG.
Other sources of extra bubble levels exist like zenith market; only the crook stamp progresses past that and it dwarfs everything else but can't be targeted.
Crook stamp hits are pure RNG; he has about 52,000 from lucky stamp hits. Hard to rate Crook because of this.
Only the Bob bubble (Call Me Bob) really matters for Crook since it scales linearly; main stat bubbles hit heavy diminishing returns.
You can candy click and push the main stat bubbles yourself: roid raging easy to candy click, swift stepping less so, wood easy; lock bubble useful but pushable.
Larry bubble can be pushed with atom clicks and hits diminishing returns very quickly; Hammer goes on forever but the anvil gets too fast.
Crook is good early game and terrible mid game; best at pushing Bob in endgame. Early to mid game players lack other sources unless stamp hits.
Crook bubble talent is a solid B tier; 10 bubble levels per point is not a great return.
Familiar Fireside: 80% chance buying a summoning familiar does not raise the cost; deceptive wording.
The free chance doesn't consume attempts, so you get extra clicks and extra familiars; level stays the same and you keep clicking.
Familiar Fireside gave him hundreds of extra clicks; theoretically 5x the familiars per 3 days, massively accelerates summoning.
Familiar Fireside is easily an S tier pickup even though the description doesn't make that clear.
Superb Gallerium is really bad: if you max gallery slots it gives nothing more, and its description is deceptive.
Superb Gallerium raises the base amount of gallery slots by +1 rather than grade by +1; only up to about tier two, no tier three.
Superb Gallerium is D tier; you could leave it at zero points. He only maxed it 3 days ago due to spare points.
Daily Shopping Spree: the first 48 masterclass upgrades bought each day are 80% cheaper.
Daily Shopping Spree is straight S tier and necessary for progression; Royal Guardian is only really pushable with this.
Inevitable Builder adds one trimmed (golden) construction slot and makes them multiplier faster; he gets 64x.
Inevitable Builder is very good for construction but with diminishing returns; not worth five points compared with Daily Shopping Spree; better than cattle croc.
Inevitable Builder is A tier, one of the most debatable placements.
Guaranteed crystal mob talent got nerfed from 21x to 4x; now 364 daily guaranteed; previously clear S tier.
Crystal mob talent is still really good as a one pointer but now A tier; not prioritized over the S tiers.
Talent gives 3,500% drop rate to all players at 500 per level; many points; good for world 7 players with single to double digit drop rate.
Drop rate talent is a high B tier because it is expensive in points, though good later when multiplied.
Thanatos? Teaching gives 1000 extra kills for opening portals and Death Note; additive not a multiplier.
Extra kills talent is solid B: useful for Death Note (eclipse skulls) but they were doing that easily without it.
Gold food bonus talent is additive not a multiplier, yet is a top three source of gold food bonus; biggest sources are from cooking.
Yummy Pea Shrink? in cooking gives him 92,000% gold food; the legend talent source gives 15,500%. Top three sources excluding pay to win.
Gold food bonus talent is B tier: strong but not at the level of the A tiers.
Prisma bubbles and exalted stamps bonus is 15% higher; both are among the strongest mechanics in the game.
Prisma and exalted talent is expensive (3% per point) and comparable to the S tier familiar talent; five pointer versus two pointer.
Prisma/exalted stamp talent is S tier after debate; those mechanics are just so strong.
Coral Restoration gives more daily coral; coral is strong: gallery 30% bonuses amazing, brain coral trash, anemone coral adds a bonus, ninja knowledge is niche.
He has 3 million coral and doesn't need more; no coral update since World 7 came out, so extra coral isn't meta relevant now.
Coral Restoration is C tier; maybe it rises if future updates need coral.
Skillium Fancy multiplies exp gain for all skills except research and the W7 skill three (including spelunking); hard multiplier.
Skillium Fancy is a point hog (seven points with research node) but high A tier, maybe low S.
Big Sig Fig makes sigils and alchemy level up 10x faster; niche; he has two sigils left (eclectic tier) and it helps.
Sigils give some good things (true damage multi with research nodes liquid rates sigil-on-sigil refinery base stats) but extra crystals got nerfed; lots of trash.
Big Sig Fig is hard C tier: sigils aren't the most insane mechanic and it's a massive point hog.
Refinery cycles are X faster; strong for its niche but not needed.
Refinery cycle talent is high C tier: refinery stronger than sigils and fewer points but not as good as croc.
Yet another printer multi: printer output multiplier each day for 20 days, resets when taking a new sample.
Printer multi is not the strongest but not bad; the most B tier of B tiers.
Higher exp gain for laboratory and divinity (exp only not points); stacks with other exp sources; lab opal jewels are given free at break points.
Lab/divinity exp talent is solid B; if you need it your exping needs fixing since breakpoints were hit in world 5 and 6 without it.
Pure Bread Eggs raises the chance for breeding eggs to rank up (10x higher than normal); niche, one pointer.
Pure Bread Eggs is a niche within a niche but not bad; B tier.
David Jones Returns gives bonus to the same stats as David Jones training (World 5 gem shop) and also reduces minimum travel time.
David Jones talent rated low originally but proved stronger than thought; sits in B tier, not amazing.
Villagers at the hole gain more exp: three pointer; high B tier since many other sources of villager exp.
Best Story Ever Told: 4x higher reward multi for all monument stories in World 5 cabins plus reward multi build up for an extra 300 hours.
Best Story Ever Told is middle of the pack A tier, not S for six points.
Gets 6x more levels when buying exotic market upgrades; one of the very few ways to increase exotic market, which is strong.
Exotic market talent is high A tier at minimum, borderline low S; not meta defining but really good.
The Charms Got Rid: all gold charms give 2.25x higher bonuses; he levelled it a few days ago.
Gold charm talent is niche for sneaking; C tier since lots of points for something just okay.
6x better luck when using blessings in the sneaking inventory.
Blessing luck talent is C tier like gold charms: not useless but many points for something just okay.
Gold charms refer to certain items in sneaking; he has no symbols to show; levels up the squares.
Lightning Fast Naps gives faster stamina regeneration for spelunking; 2.25x multiplier for five points; even as spelunking main he struggles to put points in.
Stamina regen talent is high B tier, doesn't squeak into A.
For engagement bait he puts stamina regen at A on the infographic, though for viewers he says B tier.
Fairy Friends Forever makes bonuses from friends Orion and Poppy 11x bigger; he gets 5000% drop rate from Orion alone and 1.3k AFK gains.
Fairy Friends Forever is a five pointer now high A tier since Orion and Poppy got buffs over time.
Actively equipped cards give 1.75x higher bonuses and stack lab chips; his drop rate is 355,000.
Cards are some of the biggest gains in the game; swapping cards gave over 50k drop rate; five pointer, S tier meta defining.
Picasso Gaming makes all bonuses from gaming palette colors 2.25x higher; palette has many good things like mossy green (cell damage) and prisma bonus.
Gaming palette talent is a five pointer; strong, scales decently, not as strong as cards, min A tier.
Picasso Gaming gets A tier, upgraded to A+ along with stamina regen after adding plus grades.
Slab bigger bonuses in world 5: low points needed, just okay, high B tier.
Higher bonuses from jar collectibles in cavern 11; two key jar collectibles to push: rose emerald and a mint? gem.
Rose emerald gives faster villager study rate; his study rate is 1.4 million, mostly rose emerald; negative opals happened for unknown reason.
Early game push monument AFK gain rate jar to push bravery, get to 100k then swap off to Rose Emerald to push villager study rate.
Jar collectible talent is a five point 2x point hog but the two collectibles are good; B+.
Democracy for the Win gives higher bonuses for the winning bonus of the week; strong if divinity week, useless if voted additive exp.
Ballot talent has two ratings: S or D since it can be useless.
Meritocracy multiplier for the wing bonus is never useless; minimum S tier and might be S+.
Revisiting: super talents get S+.
Shrines no matter where is straight A.
Recycled particle (unspent) gets D minus.
Obsolete No More is a one pointer for a meta defining upgrade so S+.
Statue and gold food drop talent is S+.
Ribbons every day is straight A despite many points.
Land rank talent gets A tier.
Jeweled cogs straight A tier.
Cattle croc bubbles upgraded to B+.
Summoning familiar talent is straight S; ephemeral since useless after a point but more useful early.
Gallerium gets straight D.
Daily shopping spree is meta defining so probably S+ (A+ said).
Trimmed construction slot talent is straight A: very good at its niche but many points.
Guaranteed crystal mobs now A+; before the nerf it was probably S+, a full grade down.
Drop rate talent B+ since many points.
Extra kills talent is B.
Gold food bonus is B+: second best source outside pay to win.
Prisma and exalted talent finalized as S, on par with the familiar talent even at five points.
Daily coral C minus for now, could be good later.
Higher exp for all gains is on the edge of S so A+.
Sigils talent solid C.
Refinery cycles C+, could be B.
Printer output multi stays B, most B tier of B tiers.
Lab and divinity exp gets B+ due to early and late game usage and being a one pointer.
Davy Jones talent B+ (pointed out solid B) as three points.
Both sneaking charm talents solid C.
Stamina regeneration for spelunking gets A minus though he still thinks B tier.
A five node talent (likely cards) gets S+.
He compares today's tier list to his earlier guide from a year ago.
Yellow one was S previously and agrees today.
Yellow three previously A, now S as a one pointer; agrees with last year's Paul on needing to go back up.
Unspent/recycled previously D and still D.
Yellow five and six were S previously and S today.
Ribbon per day was B and is A today, a big increase.
Ribbon income still A minus: timegated and new mechanic needs over 20; not straight A.
Jeweled cogs per day was A and still A.
Yellow 10 cattle croc was B and is B.
Red one previously S and S today.
Red two was C and today D; they didn't understand how it worked back then.
Red three previously S, S+ today.
Red four was A and A today; same for red five.
Red six drop rate was B+ and is bumped to A minus; a lot of points to spend.
Red seven was C, today B.
Golden food multi was B and is B today.
Red nine prisma was S and S today.
Daily coral was C and is C.
Brown one was S and gets A+ today; could be S minus.
Brown two sigil speed was C and is C.
Brown three was B and went down to C+.
Brown four printer was C and is B today; could drop to B minus.
Lab exp gain was B and still B.
Breeding egg rank up chance was C and is B.
David Jones was C and went up to B; could be B minus.
Hole and hole villager exp were C and are B; he was kinder today.
Monument rewards were S and A+ today.
Exotic market purchases were S and A+ today.
Sneaking charms and blessing luck were C and are C.
Green three stamina regen was B and A minus today (also B).
Green four Orion and Poppy was A and A.
Green five equipped cards was S and S.
Gaming pallet was S and A+ today.
Slab and jar collectibles were C and B+ today.
Ballot bonus was B with a caveat that it could be D or S.
Green X meritocracy was S and S.
Little changed overall; crystal spawn nerf was the biggest move (a full tier); red two learned to be useless.
Get all S tiers first since universally amazing then A tiers; after that is personal preference. S and A tier are pretty much must gets.
Prioritize one point talents since they give full value immediately; he now takes point cost into account.
Be sparing; keep maybe 5 or 10 points in reserve because a future patch or final row may give strong new content to buff immediately.
Players told to keep one point for the research update actually needed 12 and some 20 since nodes were in the corner; always keep more than you think.
